“不单漂亮，我们还觉得像一人！”
“嗯！”
“那天你坐车回部队，我们去送你，其中有一个女同学，你还抱人家来着！”
刘济民立即抬头，满脸冤枉：“妈，您这可不敢乱说，那天的所有人我都抱了！”
“咦！我还不懂你，你抱她的姿势都不对，抱的时间比抱别人整整长了三秒，还摸人家头发。关键是，我跟你爸出了车站，我总觉得有什么不对。我回头一看，你猜怎么着？”
“您说，我猜不着！”
“她也在看我，你瞧瞧，这不是看对眼了吗？人家都说，是不是儿媳妇儿，对对眼就知道了。你就别在这里装傻充愣了，年纪也不小了，前线也上了，血咱也流了，该成家立业了！”
王爱梅同志一个劲儿地追问，刘振国同志则是张着嘴傻乐，刘教导员没办法再装傻下去了。
“妈，您放心，这儿媳妇儿我一定给您娶到家。”
“明天带回来吃个饭？”
刘济民无语地说道：“明天早上吃饭，最好晚上就得入洞房是不是？”
“可以吗？中午咱就去打结婚证，人我都熟！”
“行啊！”
王爱梅冲着刘济民拍了一巴掌：“别糊弄你老娘，反正最近啊，赶紧领回来瞅瞅！”
“哎呦，哎呦，打的头晕，不行了，不行了，我得睡一觉。”刘济民放下筷子，一个趔趄躺在了床上。
翌日，刘济民一觉睡到上午十一点，等到吃完中午饭，才骑着自行车晃晃悠悠地来到学校，先去办了复学手续。
学校的老师看到刘济民后，热情地告诉他，一切手续都准备好了，只需要他签个字儿就行。另外学校还想请他做做报告，号召学生向前线战士学习。
刘济民当即同意了学校的要求，作报告也是部队宣传的一部分嘛。
此时回到学校的刘济民，无论走到哪里都是焦点。抛开他所谓“战斗英雄”的身份不谈，身上自带着战场军人特有的英雄气。
这让刘济民想找个机会跟朱霖聊聊天，也没有找到。周边围着里三层外三层的，朱霖又不是爱争的性格，自然抢不到近距离接触的机会。
没办法，谁让刘教导员炙手可热呢！
傍晚，两人终于找到了机会，来到大栅栏遛弯。大栅栏非常热闹，时不时还能看到几个洋鬼子。一阵风吹来，刘济民脑袋跟炸了似的。

“Not only are we beautiful, we feel like the same person!”
"Yeah!"
"That day you took the car back to the army and we went to see you off. There was a female classmate among them, and you hugged her!"
Liu Jimin immediately raised his head, his face full of injustice: "Mom, you don't dare to talk nonsense, I hugged everyone that day!"
"Eh! I still don't understand you. The way you held her was wrong. You held her for three seconds longer than others, and you even touched her hair. The point is, when your dad and I left the station, I always felt something was wrong. When I looked back, guess what?"
"You said, I can't guess!"
"She is also looking at me. Look, aren't we seeing each other? People say that you will know if you are a daughter-in-law or a daughter-in-law. Don't pretend to be dumb here. You are not young anymore. We are on the front line. Blood has been shed. It's time to start a family and start a career!"
Comrade Wang Aimei kept asking questions, while Comrade Liu Zhenguo opened his mouth and looked silly. Instructor Liu could no longer pretend to be stupid.
"Mom, don't worry, I will definitely get you a wife here."
"Bring it back for dinner tomorrow?"
Liu Jimin said speechlessly: "For dinner tomorrow morning, it's best to go to the bridal chamber at night, right?"
"Is that okay? Let's go get the marriage certificate at noon. I know everyone well!"
"Okay!"
Wang Aimei slapped Liu Jimin in the face: "Don't fool your mother, it's recent anyway, take it back and take a look!"
"Ouch, ouch, I'm so dizzy, I can't do it anymore, I can't do it anymore, I have to take a nap." Liu Jimin put down his chopsticks and staggered down on the bed.
The next day, Liu Jimin slept until eleven o'clock in the morning. After lunch, he rode his bicycle to the school and went through the resumption procedures first.
When the school teacher saw Liu Jimin, he enthusiastically told him that all the procedures were ready and he only needed to sign. In addition, the school also wants to invite him to give a report and call on students to learn from frontline soldiers.
Liu Jimin immediately agreed to the school's request. Giving a report was also part of the army's propaganda.
Liu Jimin, who has returned to school at this time, is the center of attention wherever he goes. Regardless of his so-called "combat hero" status, he possesses the unique heroic spirit of a battlefield soldier.
This made Liu Jimin want to find an opportunity to chat with Zhu Lin, but he couldn't find one. Surrounded by people on three levels inside and three outside, Zhu Lin was not a competitive person, so naturally he couldn't get the chance to get close to each other.
There is no way, who makes instructor Liu so popular!
In the evening, the two finally found an opportunity and came to Dashilar for a walk. Dashilan is very lively, and you can see a few foreigners from time to time. A gust of wind blew, and Liu Jimin's head felt like it was exploding.
